title: Mathership Alien Crystal Function Hypothesis Admission Audit
question: Are the alien crystals memory flash drives, computer/data devices, optical components, power components, materials, currency/valuables, or generic alien clutter?
confirmed_properties: found on some aliens and on tables/shelves among alien artifacts
Rock-It Launcher accepts them because DLC05MZ1QuestScript explicitly adds both forms to RockItLauncherAmmo
39 crystals are present in Robot Assembly, the largest single-area quantity documented
36 are documented in the Hangar, with additional groups across Living Quarters, Observation Deck, Cryo Lab, Engineering Core and Weapons Lab
unused DLC05TestAlienTech groups three small crystals with alien epoxy, alien squid food and a modifiable healing archway
unused DLC05TestPhil places large/small crystals next to numerous prototype alien-clutter categories including generic labels such as Tool, Gizmo, Imager, Device, Unidentified Material and Mechanism
negative_evidence_or_absence: no reviewed shipped script was found that reads data from a crystal
no reviewed shipped script was found that writes data to a crystal
no reviewed shipped interaction sockets a crystal into a terminal, console, memory device or machine
crystals are not documented as ammunition/power source for Zetan energy weapons; those use separate alien power cells/modules
the names Small/Large alien crystal do not encode a memory, data, lens or battery role

hypotheses.description: crystals are portable data/memory storage analogous to flash drives
support: crystalline media is technologically plausible in fiction
some crystals visually appear among technological clutter
counter: high bulk counts in robot assembly/hangar fit commodity/component/material at least as well
separate generic Imager/Device prototype names are not bound to the actual crystal records

hypotheses.description: crystals are lenses/optical or sensor components
support: crystal form and technological distribution are compatible with optical use
counter: no exact machine attachment or optical field binding recovered

support: very high quantities in Robot Assembly and Hangar
broad distribution across technical ship areas

counter: separate alien power cell/module systems are explicitly used by weapons

support: carryable items have cap values; some aliens carry them
counter: cap value is player-economy metadata, not Zetan currency evidence
no alien trade system uses them

hypotheses.description: crystals are primarily collectible alien clutter in shipped gameplay
support: wiki-documented actual uses are trade, decoration and Rock-It ammunition
no stronger scripted lore role recovered
counter: in-world technological function could exist but remain unstated

proposed_extraction_test.name: CRYSTAL_REFERENCE_COLOCATION_AND_SCRIPT_BINDING
targets: export exact placed references of small/large crystals from Zeta.esm
calculate distance/co-location with terminals, consoles, robot-assembly machinery, healing arches and research devices
search all scripts/quests/packages for DLC05AlienCrystalSmall/Large references
search container ownership and actor inventories
test whether crystal placement clusters statistically more around machinery than generic loot
proposed_extraction_test.claim_ceiling: Co-location can rank hypotheses but cannot prove function without a use/attachment/script/dialogue edge.

next_gate.name: CRYSTAL_REFERENCE_COLOCATION_AND_USE_EDGE_GATE
required_for_function_admission: record field that assigns device role

source_register.role: test-cell co-location with healing arch and alien consumables/materials
